item.text:
Implemented the admin product catalog page with a shared product loader cached under the `products` tag. The regular HTML form uses an inline Server Action that calls `revalidateTag('products', 'max')`. Submitting it returns promptly; a later catalog read can serve briefly stale data while the cache refreshes in the background. Other views can use the same loader and tag.

The page is in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx), with the cached loader in [lib/products.ts](/workspace/lib/products.ts). I updated Next.js to 16.4.5 for the two-argument `revalidateTag` API.

`npm run build` passed, and a production smoke test confirmed that the page renders and the form submits. The current [data source](/workspace/lib/db.js) is sample data, so live ERP/PIM changes will appear once that function reads the real source.
